subject: Television & Streaming
title: Taylor Sheridan's Rural Empire
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Taylor Sheridan's Rural Empire.

hook.text: Yellowstone debuted quietly on Paramount Network and became the most-watched show on cable television.

buildup.text: Taylor Sheridan's Rural Empire sets up the core claim, the assumptions, and the stakes.

discovery.text: Sheridan launched four spinoffs in three years. He writes nearly every episode himself across all his shows.

twist.text: Critics are divided. Some call his work brilliant Americana. Others call it conservative nostalgia dressed up as drama.

climax.text: Sheridan proved that rural America is an underserved audience.

punchline.text: Hollywood forgot about cowboys. One writer brought them back.

quiz.question: What underserved audience did Taylor Sheridan's shows successfully target?
